desc_en: The DAZ Luxury convertible backpack combines refined functionality with contemporary design. Crafted with a waterproof synthetic leather exterior and a scratch-resistant polyester lining, this piece offers a versatile daily solution. It features a main compartment with a smooth zipper closure, an additional front pocket, and adjustable shoulder straps that allow a seamless transition between carrying styles. Made to order. Worldwide shipping.
desc_es: La mochila convertible DAZ Luxury combina funcionalidad depurada con un diseño contemporáneo. Confeccionada con exterior de cuero sintético impermeable y un forro de poliéster resistente a los arañazos, esta pieza ofrece una solución versátil para el día a día. Dispone de un compartimento principal con cierre de cremallera suave, un bolsillo frontal adicional y tirantes ajustables que permiten una transición fluida entre estilos de transporte. Made to order. Worldwide shipping.
